hypotheses.C1_routing_beats_global32_local_fisher: The soft routed program reduces opposite-half Fisher error by at least 20% relative to the fixed global rank-32 quotient.
hypotheses.C2_exact_kl_router_beats_global32_ood: After exact-KL fine-tuning, the soft router reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% relative to global rank 32 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_task_aware_router_improves_ce: The task-aware router has mean next-token CE delta at most zero on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_hard_routing_retains_gain: Hard routing retains at least 80% of the soft exact-KL router's gain over global rank 32 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_router_uses_multiple_experts: The exact-KL router has effective mean-gate support at least three on every corpus.
hypotheses.C6_routed_rank8_reaches_behavioral_gate: The exact-KL soft router has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C7_exact_objective_improves_fisher_route: Exact-KL fine-tuning lowers mean exact KL relative to the Fisher-trained router on every corpus.
